description: Three stereo send and return loops on a bus chain, one per bus, each with a sample delay for latency compensation and a stereo mix out of all three

params.text: Delays the blue stereo bus by 0 to 999 samples before it reaches the blue SEND jacks or BUS OUT, to line it up with a bus that has been through a latent effect
Delays the orange stereo bus by 0 to 999 samples before it reaches the orange SEND jacks or BUS OUT, to line it up with a bus that has been through a latent effect
Delays the red stereo bus by 0 to 999 samples before it reaches the red SEND jacks or BUS OUT, to line it up with a bus that has been through a latent effect
Switches the blue stereo bus into the sends and into BUS OUT, or out of them, over a 26ms fade; a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions the blue bus. Its RETURN jacks arrive either way
Switches the orange stereo bus into the sends and into BUS OUT, or out of them, over a 26ms fade; a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions the orange bus. Its RETURN jacks arrive either way
Switches the red stereo bus into the sends and into BUS OUT, or out of them, over a 26ms fade; a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions the red bus. Its RETURN jacks arrive either way

inputs.text: Feeds the left channel of the blue stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the blue send is passing; it arrives whether or not the blue bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Feeds the right channel of the blue stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the blue send is passing; it arrives whether or not the blue bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Feeds the left channel of the orange stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the orange send is passing; it arrives whether or not the orange bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Feeds the right channel of the orange stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the orange send is passing; it arrives whether or not the orange bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Feeds the left channel of the red stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the red send is passing; it arrives whether or not the red bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Feeds the right channel of the red stereo bus on BUS OUT, added to whatever the red send is passing; it arrives whether or not the red bus is switched on, so an effect tail can ring out
Takes the three stereo buses from another module's BUS OUT, and they are what the sends and the sample delays work on

outputs.text: The left channel of the blue stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either blue SEND jack takes the blue bus off BUS OUT, leaving the blue RETURN jacks to bring it back
The right channel of the blue stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either blue SEND jack takes the blue bus off BUS OUT, leaving the blue RETURN jacks to bring it back
The left channel of the orange stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either orange SEND jack takes the orange bus off BUS OUT, leaving the orange RETURN jacks to bring it back
The right channel of the orange stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either orange SEND jack takes the orange bus off BUS OUT, leaving the orange RETURN jacks to bring it back
The left channel of the red stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either red SEND jack takes the red bus off BUS OUT, leaving the red RETURN jacks to bring it back
The right channel of the red stereo bus, after its sample delay; patching either red SEND jack takes the red bus off BUS OUT, leaving the red RETURN jacks to bring it back
Carries the three stereo buses on one polyphonic cable: each bus as it comes back from its RETURN jacks, or straight through with its sample delay applied where that bus has no send patched
The left channels of all three stereo buses summed, after the sends and returns
The right channels of all three stereo buses summed, after the sends and returns

notes: this module does nothing until another Glue the Giant module's BUS OUT is patched into its BUS IN; that chain is what the sends, the returns and the sample delays work on
holding one of the three bus buttons for 0.7 seconds auditions that bus and mutes the other two; holding a second adds it. A single click ends the audition, which reaches no other module
